notes: Validated against Gilbert et al. Nat Struct Mol Biol 2008 (doi:10.1038/nsmb.1371). SAM-II riboswitch from Thermoanaerobacter tengcongensis. Chain A, SAM at A:100. Adenosyl moiety of SAM stacks on G11 and contacts A24/A25/A26 via Watson-Crick-like H-bonds. Methionine sulfonium (SD) contacts A42/A43 backbone. Completely different fold from SAM-I (2YGH) despite identical ligand — used as paired case to show fold-dependent scoring. CS (cesium) and MG removed per ion policy. PO4 crystallization ions removed.
